title: Create with Virtuse: data, columns and listings
description: Embed live Bitcoin data, write for the Virtuse Brief and get listed in our Bitcoin ecosystem. For creators, podcasters and meetups.
lead: You teach people about Bitcoin. We publish data, fee comparisons and a weekly brief. Use ours, write for us, get listed.
s1_p: Three live tables you can put on your site in one line of code. They update by themselves and credit the source. Free, no sign-up.
s2_p: One guest column a month in the Virtuse Brief and our Magazine, with your name, photo and a link to your work. Bitcoin only, no tokens, no paid promotion.
s3_p: Podcasts, channels, newsletters and meetups that teach Bitcoin get a card in our Bitcoin ecosystem, in ten languages.
s4_p: A share of every full Verdict report your audience buys. We publish the terms here once they are ready.
rules_1: Your work is about Bitcoin, not tokens or altcoins.
rules_2: You say clearly when something is a partnership.
rules_3: You never present Virtuse as investment or tax advice. We do not give it.
cta_note: Tell us your name, channel and audience size. We reply within 14 days.
kit_p: Four images from our data, in two sizes. Post them with the source.
kit_usd_total: Total return in US dollars. Past returns do not guarantee future returns.
kit_ar_note: Bitcoin ranks {rank} of {n} asset classes. Total return in US dollars. Past returns do not guarantee future returns.
kit_fee_note: Listed fee plus estimated spread, for one €100 buy.
kit_mr_note: Higher in {pos} of {n} years, {first} to {last}. US dollars. Past returns do not guarantee future returns.
